title: optional, variant and string_view
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas of optional, variant and string_view.
Identify the language rules and relevant C++ constructs.
Apply the topic in a small program.
Recognize common pitfalls and safety concerns.
Test an example and justify design decisions.

understand.concept: optional represents a possibly absent value, variant holds one alternative from a type set, and string_view is a non-owning view. string_view does not extend the source lifetime.
understand.whyItMatters: These types communicate absence/alternatives and can reduce copies; lifetime mistakes with views can be serious.
understand.explain: Check optional before access; use variant alternatives safely; ensure the string_view source remains alive and stable.
